notes.title: Faerie Solitaire Dire is now in Early Access!
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1563770/c844573d192deab079657ac94129c20257fba5cd.jpg

Faerie Solitaire Dire is now in Early Access!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/556530/Faerie_Solitaire_Dire/

Here are two threads with information worth reading:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/556530/discussions/0/2943620809073645581/

https://steamcommunity.com/app/556530/discussions/0/2914346777816001125/

tl;dr


 The game is not finished yet. The game is still sold as is. That is how Early Access works.
 Dire is closely related to Faerie Solitaire Remastered but with a darker theme and much more focus on challenging content. It can still be played in a more relaxed way if you choose Relaxed as your difficulty when creating a profile. If you have never played any of our previous solitaires you probably should before attempting Dire.
 Our estimated full release date is 2 months from today. If you want to wait to buy until full release please make sure the game is on your wishlist today.
 There will be bugs. There will be lack of polish. There will be some obviously missing content.
 Please opt in to error reporting. It really helps us fix bugs faster. This is the first thing you will see when launching the game.
 We authorize any and all refunds if you are not happy and want one. We want you to be happy with your purchase.  Show this to Valve if you want a refund and they for some reason deny you a refund.
 We will be updating as often as we have an update ready, and will do weekly posts on Fridays with lists of changes. You can subscribe to threads in the forum to be notified about specific things that interest you.
 We have a Discord, you can find the invite link on the About screens of any of our recent games.
 For anything we will be adding to the game we don't want to preview it at all until it's in the game and playable. Minus some exceptions, this is how we will deal with upcoming content additions. If you have played our previous games you can have some idea of what is to come.
 If you notice issues you can contact us directly at help@subsoap.com or mention it in our Subsoap Discord or post about it in the forum. Check the known issues thread in the forum first.

notes.title: FAERIE SOLITAIRE HARVEST LIBRARY UPDATE
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34607415/b8565891ea13bb5dbed156e0ebd73da4347a7b5a.png

If you have not reviewed FSH yet please do! Every review counts and is greatly appreciated! Total reviews help drive sales, which means more free updates like this one are possible.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/348910/Faerie_Solitaire_Harvest/

We've been hard at work since launch improving and polishing Faerie Solitaire Harvest to be even better than before. Besides tons of extra attention to detail and optimizations, we've also included an entirely new section to the game we are calling the Library.

Behold the exciting new additions of this update:

 - New Talents where you can gain new powerful abilities.
 - New Lore to discover as you play the game.
 - New Valor for greater risk and reward.

Unlock the Blab talent ASAP! :)

-------------------

Want the patch notes? Here they are:


ENTER THE LIBRARY!
Unlock Powerful Talents! 
Discover Fascinating Lore! 
Show Your Valor!

__________________________________________________________

Goal Changes
- Changing "No Wild" to "Using a Wild".

- Added "Never Break a Combo", worth 1,000 pure.
- Added "Celestial" combo tier, worth 1,000 pure.

- Increasing "Using Wild" bonus from 100 to 150 pure.
- Increasing "No Spare" bonus from 100 pure to 200 pure.
- Increasing "No Deck" bonus from 100 pure to 500 pure.
- Increasing "All-Out" bonus from 1000 pure to 2000 pure.
- Increasing "Left over Deck" bonus multiplier from x5 to x10. Example: (26 cards in a deck = 260 pure).
- Increasing "Highest Combo" bonus multiplier from x10 to x15. Example: (22 combo = 330 pure).

__________________________________________________________

Drop changes
- Adjusted drop rates.
    - Decreased Pet drop rates ~5%.
    - Decreased Item drop rates ~2%.
    - Decreased Resource drop rates ~2%.
    - Decreased bonus from NGP bonus ~5%.
(Note these are done in part for the new talents buffing drop rates by a lot more.)

__________________________________________________________

Valor
- Added New Valor system.

Valor is an optional system that will allow players to give themselves a more difficult playthrough.

You must meet the conditions to unlock each of the 7 Valor perks.

Each Valor perk you have enabled will increase the maximum amount of XP you get per completed hand and other benifits.

__________________________________________________________

Valor XP/Leveling
- Added New XP/Leveling system.
    - Every level will grant players 1 Talent point.
    - After reaching level 100, your next level up will reset your level to 1 and give you 1 Prestige Level.

Currently Prestige Levels do not grant anything special and are just for bragging rights (you still gain a bonus per each normal level up).

__________________________________________________________

Talents
- Added New Talent system.

We've added in 36 Talents into the game. These Talents will buff various different parts of the game as you play.

You will need Talent points and pure to unlock Talent perks. The cost of talent points and pure will depend on the Talents' Rank.

Some Talent Perks can be upgraded past their initial rank.

You gain Talent points from completing locations (finishing all 9 hands and freeing the faerie or unlocking a loot box) and from leveling up.

Plus a ton of extra random polish, love, and care!



Please enjoy this update and look forward to our next game Dire.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/556530/Faerie_Solitaire_Dire/

Want to join our Discord community? Check the in game about screen for invite links!

notes.title: New 2018 Beta
notes.content:
A new better late than never version is on the 2018 beta branch. You will need to switch to this "2018_beta" branch to play this update. Once enough people confirm that it works as intended I will graduate it to live.

If you play this please give feedback on if you notice it being better. Maybe create a new profile to test with if you feel up to it.

The changes specifically: 
* The chance for all eggs to drop is much higher now. Shouldn't be too high to make the egg hunt unfun, but let me know if it's too high or not.
* After you purchase the Tree of Life powerup the drop rates for eggs go even higher to prevent the need for endless grind. So if you already have Tree of Life powerup unlocked you can enjoy the even higher rates. There is no tool tip for the powerup for this effect but it is in game.
* Egg shop removed. It's more fun to get eggs in game than buy them.

If you previously played but never got the last egg achievements and lost your save (or played the older beta with egg shop and got a glitch) you can download this save to use to complete the last two achivements: https://www.subsoap.com/temp/FaerieSolitaireClassicSavegame.zip

Put the files in the folder in the zip in your C:\Users\Username\AppData\Roaming\Faerie Solitaire

This update is unfortunately still only for Windows for technical reasons. It would be possible to make new Mac/Linux builds but I will need to rewrite some of the dependencies this version of the game uses which have only Windows versions. Maybe in 2019.

For anyone who got all of the eggs in the original version, just know you beat RNGesus.

This is still not the final update to this classic version but I'm still pressed for time so I'll have to budget more time in 2019 to make some more changes and quality of life updates before the final update for this game is released.

I still also encourage people to play the Remastered version once we get the engine rework released for it. Should be Soon(TM). :colorlessfaerie:
